## The problem

<!-- A concrete situation where the module didn't do what you needed.
     A real site, a real embed, a real visitor outcome. Not "it would
     be nice if…" — what got in your way? -->

## What you'd want instead

<!-- The behavior change. A new provider, a new language, a new option,
     a different default, a new CSS hook. -->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- Did you work around it via `options.providers` / `options.strings`?
     Is there an existing option that almost does it? For new providers,
     can the visitor already register them themselves? -->

## Scope check

<!-- See CONTRIBUTING.md for what fits. New top-level options on the
     API surface and any change that widens the contract are usually
     discussed before any PR. New providers and new languages are
     usually fine to PR directly — one per PR. -->
